context: Asuka and Ren arrange a guest lecture.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic arrangement; vocabulary (いれ/いただく/講義/取る/事前) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 特別な講義を、お願いできますか?
lines.en: May I ask you for a special lecture?
lines.style: polite young student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、喜んで引き受けさせていただきます。
lines.en: Yes, I'll gladly take it on.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事前に、資料をいただけますか?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事前に、要点をまとめて入れておきますね。
lines.en: I'll compile and include the key points in advance.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 講義の時間は、どれくらい取りますか?
lines.en: How much time should we allot for the lecture?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一時間ほど、取らせていただきます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 質問の時間も、入れて下さいね。
lines.en: Please include time for questions too.
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事前のご依頼、ありがたくいただきます。
lines.en: I gratefully accept your advance request.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
